info.name: Omar Obeid - Services 7-9 (Vulnerabilities, Notifications, Playbooks)
info.description:
EECE 435L Final Project, Sprint I - Security Incident Detection and Response Management System.
Developer: Omar Obeid.

Run `python seed.py --reset`, start `python app.py`, then run the folders in order (Authentication first: it stores the tokens).

item.name: 1. Vulnerability Management Service (Omar Obeid)
Omar Obeid - Create Vulnerability - High (CVSS 7.5)

request.description:
**Developer:** Omar Obeid

**Caller:** Security Administrator. **Expected:** HTTP 201.

Records CVE-2021-41773 on asset 1. A High/Critical vulnerability also sends a Vulnerability Alert notification to the asset owner. Stores `vulnerability_id`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Apache HTTP Server path traversal",
  "description": "Path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49",
  "cve_identifier": "CVE-2021-41773",
  "cvss_score": 7.5,
  "severity_level": "High",
  "affected_asset_id": 1,
  "discovery_source": "Nessus scan"
}

exec: pm.test('developer is Omar Obeid', () => pm.expect(body.developer).to.eql('Omar Obeid'));
